content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Toptal: Enterprise Sales Development Representative Anywhere in the World California All Other Remote Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> remote <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.toptal.com/">https://www.toptal.com/</a> </p> <h3>Job Summary:</h3> <p>As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!</p> <p>This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.</p> <h3>Responsibilities:</h3> <p><em>The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Sales:</strong> Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.</li> <li><strong>Begin the Relationship:</strong> Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.</li> <li><strong>Client and Industry Knowledge:</strong> Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with Team Members:</strong> You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.</li> <li><strong>Growth and Development:</strong> Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.</li> </ul> <h4>In the first week, expect to:</h4> <ul> <li>Onboard and integrate into Toptal.</li> <li>Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.</li> <li>Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.</li> <li>Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.</li> <li>Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.</li> <li>Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.</li> </ul> <h4>In the first month, expect to:</h4> <ul> <li>Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.</li> <li>Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).</li> <li>Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.</li> <li>Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.</li> <li>Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.</li> </ul> <h4>In the first three months, expect to:</h4> <ul> <li>Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.</li> <li>Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.</li> <li>Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.</li> <li>Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.</li> <li>Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.</li> </ul> <h4>In the first six months, expect to:</h4> <ul> <li>Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.</li> <li>Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.</li> <li>Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.</li> <li>Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.</li> </ul> <h4>In the first year, expect to:</h4> <ul> <li>Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.</li> <li>Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications and Job Requirements:</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree is required.</li> <li>1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.</li> <li>Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.</li> <li>Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.</li> <li>Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.</li> <li>Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.</li> <li>Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.</li> <li>Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.</li> <li>Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.</li> <li>Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.</li> <li>Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.</li> <li>Communication.
